startup.title: Compose the process
startup.summary: Build dedicated worker dependencies and per-run connector composition at explicit startup.
talk: Build dedicated worker dependencies and per-run connector composition at explicit startup.

process.title: Poll independently
process.summary: A supervised loop invokes tick, handles ownership/store uncertainty and observes stop signals.
talk: A supervised loop invokes tick, handles ownership/store uncertainty and observes stop signals.

tick.title: Recover, then claim
tick.summary: Reconcile nonterminal work, claim a run, enter the renewable lease and execute.
talk: Reconcile nonterminal work, claim a run, enter the renewable lease and execute.

recovery.title: Reconcile durable outcome
recovery.summary: Delegate to the store to determine publication outcome before permitting replacement work.
talk: Delegate to the store to determine publication outcome before permitting replacement work.

recoverStore.title: Recover lost work
recoverStore.summary: Coordinate recovery through the publication store.
talk: Coordinate recovery through the publication store.

reconcile.title: Inspect publication history
reconcile.summary: Resolve committed publication before declaring unpublished lost work interrupted.
talk: A healthy lease prevents an ordinary recovery pass from interrupting its owner. Unpublished interrupted runs need explicit Admin retry.

claim.title: Commit a fenced claim
claim.summary: Claim accepted work with an owner identity, epoch and bounded lease.
talk: Claim accepted work with an owner identity, epoch and bounded lease.

lease.title: Renew alongside execution
lease.summary: A background thread periodically extends the worker’s temporary ownership while the main thread processes the refresh.
talk: The current constructor defaults to a heartbeat every 10 seconds and a 60-second lease. These are code defaults, not measured runtime settings.
Renewal runs separately so a long retrieval or modeling step does not prevent heartbeats.
A renewal error is saved and raised by the pipeline’s ownership checks. Publication independently requires a matching live owner.
When execution leaves the lease context, it stops and joins the renewal thread.

heartbeat.title: Renew ownership
heartbeat.summary: Check the live owner fence and extend its lease using database time.
talk: Check the live owner fence and extend its lease using database time.

check.title: Surface lost renewal
check.summary: Propagate a failed renewal to the per-run connector checks.
talk: Propagate a failed renewal to the per-run connector checks.

execute.title: Execute committed work
execute.summary: Validate the claim and frozen run before source or baseline work.
talk: Validate the claim and frozen run before source or baseline work.

close.title: Close owned dependencies
close.summary: Stop polling and close explicitly constructed resources once.
talk: Stop polling and close explicitly constructed resources once.

owner.title: RefreshOwner
owner.summary: The fence combines run, process identity and epoch.
talk: The fence combines run, process identity and epoch.

releaseOwner.title: Invalidate the old owner
releaseOwner.summary: Release occupied coordination and advance the epoch inside the recovery or completion transaction.
talk: Release occupied coordination and advance the epoch inside the recovery or completion transaction.

flows.title: High-level diagram
flows.lead: The independently supervised worker recovers unfinished state, claims accepted work and maintains a renewable ownership lease while executing it.
flows.heading: One committed owner carries a run to completion.

lanes.title: Process an accepted run
lanes.caption: The worker polls PostgreSQL. The heartbeat continues throughout pipeline execution, independently of the browser and API request.

steps.title: Reconcile unfinished work
steps.text: Check whether earlier work already published or still has a healthy owner.

steps.title: Claim accepted work
steps.text: Commit the run’s owner, lease and ownership version before source retrieval.

steps.title: Send a heartbeat while processing
steps.text: A background thread tells PostgreSQL the worker is still active while the refresh pipeline runs.

steps.title: Build and publish safely
steps.text: Execute using the admitted configuration and current owner checks.

steps.title: Return to polling
steps.text: Finish the execution lifetime, join renewal and wait for more work.

lanes.title: Recover after owner loss
lanes.caption: Recovery checks publication history before deciding what happened; it never guesses the outcome of an uncertain commit.

steps.title: Check durable history
steps.text: Serialize recovery and inspect ownership and prior publication.

steps.title: Recover success
steps.text: Recognize the committed generation without retrieving the source again.

lanes.title: If no publication exists and the owner is lost
lanes.caption: This is the alternative recovery outcome, not a step after successful recovery.

steps.title: Invalidate the old owner
steps.text: Advance the ownership version so stale work cannot publish.

steps.title: Mark interrupted
steps.text: Record the unpublished interruption and release occupied coordination.

steps.title: Retry explicitly
steps.text: An Admin must submit a new request. Open the endpoint that accepts that explicit retry.

boundaries: An API-only restart does not stop a healthy refresh worker.
The claim expires unless renewed. Every protected write checks the run, worker identity, ownership version and live lease.
The worker closes its own resources. Database or ownership uncertainty must be reconciled before claiming a new outcome.
